cells.title: TARGET: six minutes after the forget (the 300 s tombstone has expired) a digest over the same transcript does not resurrect X
cells.note: audit F10: the tombstone is an in-process dict with a 300 s TTL and the nightly digest runs hours later, so a forgotten name returns the next night. Measured on a fake clock stepped 360 s. Becomes a hard invariant when a durable forget ledger lands
